name: fdr-portal
description: AICTE Security Deposit / FDR Management Portal - local synthetic-data prototype

scripts.test:db: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('prisma/test.db',{force:true})" && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db prisma db push --skip-generate --accept-data-loss
scripts.test: npm run test:db && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db FILE_STORE_PATH=.data/test-uploads DEMO_MODE=true TEST_CLOCK_ENABLED=true vitest run
scripts.test:watch: cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db FILE_STORE_PATH=.data/test-uploads DEMO_MODE=true TEST_CLOCK_ENABLED=true vitest
